faq.a: Exact dates for Ironman Marbella 2027 are typically confirmed by the organiser around 12 months before race day. Historically, the event is held in late April or early May. Check the official Ironman website for updates.

faq.q: How far is Puerto Banús from the Ironman finish line?
faq.a: The swim-to-run transition and finish line are on Marbella's Golden Mile, roughly 5 km from Puerto Banús. By taxi, it’s about 10 minutes. Many athletes book a transfer straight from the finish to the marina.

faq.q: Which boat is best for a small group of athletes?
faq.a: The Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39 (€749/2h) are ideal for up to 9–11 guests. Both have a shaded cockpit and a small galley for snacks. The Dubhe (€ on request) seats 5 and is perfect for a solo athlete + family.

faq.q: Can I bring my own recovery food and drinks?
faq.a: Yes. The standard charter includes water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, and light snacks. You are welcome to bring your own protein shakes, electrolyte drinks, or specific recovery meals aboard.

faq.q: Is there air conditioning on the yachts?
faq.a: All our cabin yachts (Azimut 58 Flybridge, Ferretti 94, Mangusta 80, etc.) have air-conditioned interiors. Open boats like the Speedboat or Red Tide are best for warm-weather cruising with sea breeze.

faq.q: What if I want to swim or paddle for active recovery?
faq.a: Swimming is allowed in designated coves such as Cala del Faro or Cala Cortés. The Mangusta 80 charter includes a free jet ski. We can also arrange paddleboards or snorkel gear on request.

faq.q: How do I book a post-race yacht charter?
faq.a: Book via WhatsApp for any boat not listed with fixed pricing. For Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39) you can check availability and book online. All charters require a deposit to confirm.

faq.q: What happens if the race is delayed or cancelled?
faq.a: We offer flexible rescheduling up to 48 hours before departure. If Ironman Marbella 2027 is cancelled, we will refund or rebook at no extra cost. Check our terms at booking.

data.body_html:
Crossing the finish line of Ironman Marbella 2027 is a monumental achievement. After 3.8 km of swimming, 180 km of cycling, and a full marathon, your body deserves more than a cold beer on the beach. A post-race recovery yacht charter from Puerto Banús offers the perfect blend of rest, gentle movement, and luxury — all within 10 minutes of the finish line. Whether you're a solo athlete or celebrating with a support crew, our fleet has a boat to match your recovery style.

Why choose a yacht charter for Ironman recovery?

Active recovery — light swimming, stretching on deck, or a gentle paddleboard — is proven to reduce muscle soreness and speed up repair. On a private charter, you control the pace. The Mediterranean water temperature in late April/early May is around 16–18 °C, ideal for a short, invigorating dip. Plus, the sea breeze and sun help regulate your core temperature after hours of exertion.

Best boats for small groups (up to 11 guests)

For a tight-knit group of athletes and supporters, the Astondoa 40 (12.5 m, 9 pax) or Azimut 39 (12.5 m, 11 pax) are our most popular recovery boats. At €749/2h (all inclusive), they offer a shaded cockpit, a small galley for snacks, and a licensed skipper who knows the calmest coves. You can head to Cala del Faro or Cala Cortés for a quiet swim stop, then return to port in time for a late lunch.

Larger yachts for the full support crew

If you're celebrating with family, friends, or teammates, consider the Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6 m, 12 pax) or the Mangusta 80 (24 m, 12 pax). The Mangusta 80 charter starts at €4,719/4h and includes a free jet ski — perfect for an active recovery session. The flybridge offers panoramic views of the La Concha mountain, while the air-conditioned saloon provides a cool refuge if the sun gets too strong.

Pricing and inclusions for Ironman charters

All our charters include a licensed skipper, fuel, insurance, Spanish IVA (21%), and a welcome pack of water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, and light snacks. You can bring your own recovery food and electrolyte drinks. For boats not listed with fixed pricing (e.g., Ferretti 94, Maiora 26m, Pershing 46), simply message us on WhatsApp for a custom quote. We recommend booking at least two weeks before race day, especially for larger yachts.

Recovery route: from Puerto Banús to the best coves

Departing from Puerto Banús, a typical recovery cruise heads west along the coast. Within 20 minutes you reach Cabopino with its natural dunes and quiet beach. Another 15 minutes brings you to Calahonda, where the water is often glassy. For a longer trip, continue to Estepona or even Sotogrande — both offer calm anchorages and excellent seafood restaurants. Your skipper will tailor the route to your energy levels.

What to pack for your recovery day

  • Swimwear and a light towel (we provide beach towels on request)
  • Compression gear or loose clothing
  • Sunscreen (SPF 50+) and a hat
  • Electrolyte tablets and protein shakes
  • A change of clothes for dinner at Puerto Banús

Book your Ironman Marbella 2027 recovery charter

Ready to reward yourself after the race? Browse our full fleet and check availability online for Tier A boats. For all other vessels, start a WhatsApp conversation — we'll help you pick the perfect boat and confirm your date. Spaces fill quickly for race weekend, so don't wait until the finish line to plan your recovery.
